description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He
readme_excerpt: Thanks to Kimi for sponsoring this project! Kimi K3 is the world's first open 3T-class model, featuring native vision and a 1-million-token context window. With PPT Master, K3 can understand source materials such as PDFs, DOCX files, and web pages, identify key points, structure the narrative, and generate a natively editable PPTX that you can continue refining in PowerPoint.
